name: List
description: A list of things to read and pick from — messages, orders, people, settings.

props.name: children
props.description: The items: `List.Item`s, and `List.Group`s for sections.

props.name: tag
props.description: `ol` when the order means something — steps, a ranking. Default `ul`.

parts.name: List.Item
parts.description: One thing in the list: a flex row of its parts.

props.name: children
props.description: The item's parts: `List.Media`, `List.Content`, `List.End`, `List.Actions` — or anything at all, in one row.

props.name: size
props.description: The item's spacing. Default `md`, at least 56px tall; `sm` is 44px, still a finger's width; `lg` is 72px.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets the item's parts wrap onto a second line when they do not fit, instead of squeezing.

props.name: selected
props.description: Tints the item as chosen. The state a reader hears belongs on the control that chose it — a checkbox, `aria-pressed`.

props.name: chevron
props.description: Ends the item with a chevron: pressing it goes somewhere with more. Decoration, so `aria-hidden`.

parts.name: List.Media
parts.description: The leading slot: an icon, an avatar, a thumbnail — `variant` is `icon`, `avatar` or `image`, or none for a bare icon.

props.name: children
props.description: What goes in it.

parts.name: List.Content
parts.description: The middle of an item, taking the room: a column of rows and text, which may shrink past its content.

props.name: children
props.description: What goes in it.

parts.name: List.Row
parts.description: A row inside `List.Content`: its parts side by side, the last at the end.

props.name: children
props.description: What sits side by side: a title and its time, a status and a count. The first takes the room, the last sits at the end.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets the row's parts wrap onto a new line — a set of tags — instead of pushing the last to the end.

props.name: secondary
props.description: The quieter line under the main one: smaller and muted.

parts.name: List.Overline
parts.description: A small line above the title: an id, a date, a category.

props.name: children
props.description: The text.

props.name: lines
props.description: How many lines it runs to before it stops: `1` ends in an ellipsis, `2` and `3` are clamped. Unset, it wraps.

parts.name: List.Title
parts.description: The item's name, and where its `List.Action` goes.

props.name: children
props.description: The text.

props.name: lines
props.description: How many lines it runs to before it stops: `1` ends in an ellipsis, `2` and `3` are clamped. Unset, it wraps.

parts.name: List.Description
parts.description: Muted supporting text under the title.

props.name: children
props.description: The text.

props.name: lines
props.description: How many lines it runs to before it stops: `1` ends in an ellipsis, `2` and `3` are clamped. Unset, it wraps.

parts.name: List.Meta
parts.description: A small muted value that never wraps — a time, a count — in tabular figures.

props.name: children
props.description: What goes in it.

parts.name: List.End
parts.description: The trailing slot: a value and its label, stacked and aligned to the end so a column of them lines up.

props.name: children
props.description: What goes in it.

parts.name: List.Actions
parts.description: Controls of the item's own — a switch, a menu, a checkbox — lifted above the action that covers the item.

props.name: children
props.description: What goes in it.

parts.name: List.Action
parts.description: The item's one primary action, stretched over the whole item.

props.name: children
props.description: What the action is called: the item's title, and nothing else, since it is the name a reader hears.

props.name: props
props.description: The element's attributes. An `href` makes it an `<a>`, an `htmlFor` a `<label>`; neither, a `<button type="button">`.

props.name: tag
props.description: The element, when what `props` holds does not already say: `a` with no `href` is a placeholder link.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fires on a press anywhere on the item — and on Enter, and on Space for a button.

parts.name: List.Fields
parts.description: A `<dl>` of `List.Field`s, as many to a line as fit at 8rem each.

props.name: children
props.description: What goes in it.

parts.name: List.Field
parts.description: A labelled value: a `<dt>` and a `<dd>` in a `<div>`, which is the one wrapper a `<dl>` allows.

props.name: label
props.description: What the value is: the `<dt>`.

props.name: children
props.description: The value: the `<dd>`.

parts.name: List.Group
parts.description: A section of the list: its label, then its own `<ul>` of items.

props.name: label
props.description: What the items have in common: "Today", "A", "Unread".

props.name: children
props.description: The group's items.

props.name: level
props.description: Makes the label a heading of this level, so a screen reader can jump between groups. Unset, it is plain text.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Keeps the label at the top of the screen while its items scroll under it, until the next group's pushes it off.

keyboard.action: Each item's action, then each control in its `List.Actions`.
Follows the action's link or presses its button; Space presses a button.

a11y: A `<ul role="list">`: the role is spelled out because Safari drops a list's semantics once its items lose their markers. `tag="ol"` makes it an ordered one.
`List.Action`'s name is its own text, not the whole item's — a reader hears "Ada Lovelace, link", not every value in the row.
A list is not a composite widget: every action is its own tab stop and the arrow keys stay the page's. For arrow-key selection among options, that is a listbox — `Combobox` or `Select`.
